title: Move the Docker image to a Chainguard JRE base

criteria.then: its final stage is cgr.dev/concepttocloud.com/jre:openjdk-21 pinned by sha256 digest, and every other stage is digest-pinned too
there is no docker/saiku-entrypoint, the final stage runs no shell (ENTRYPOINT and HEALTHCHECK are exec-form), CMD is ["serve"], uid/gid 10001, SAIKU_HOME, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS and EXPOSE 8080 are kept
it runs the saiku-home / secret.key pre-flight and bridges JAVA_OPTS -D properties and SAIKU_MCP_URL (ContainerPreflight, covered by ContainerPreflightTest)
a healthcheck subcommand exists and the HEALTHCHECK uses it instead of curl (HealthcheckCommandTest ships)

criteria.given: the workflows that build the image (docker.yml, release.yml)
criteria.then: each logs in to cgr.dev with CHAINGUARD_IDENTITY_ID / CHAINGUARD_TOKEN before building, and docker.yml skips the build where the secrets are absent (fork PRs)
docs/docker-chainguard-evaluation.md records the adoption decision and the 30-day pull-token rotation
